baseline_1_0_ha.label: 1.0 ha baseline ARC guideline
baseline_1_0_ha.interpretation: Historical ARC shorthand; productive allocation is 0.25 ha core food + 0.25 ha backup/perennial food + 0.50 ha coppice.

higher_resilience_1_2_ha.label: 1.2 ha Grey-Bruce higher-provisioning scenario
higher_resilience_1_2_ha.interpretation: The source text attributes 1.2 ha to a five-month Grey County growing season versus a six-month global-hectare assumption (6/5 = 1.2). It does not specify how the additional 0.2 ha is spatially allocated; proportional scaling is a new scenario assumption.
